text:
Ana (Docs): Hey team — I've opened a draft PR for the v1->v2 migration guide that specifically calls out the embed model swap and the SDK param rename. Looking for quick 👀 and any missing migration caveats before I mark it for review. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4123 :small_blue_diamond:

Brian (SDK): @Ana (Docs) thanks — I'll skim. Quick heads up: the TS SDK renamed `model` -> `modelName` and changed embed response shape for the new embed models. Need to update the code snippets and the example output JSON. :+1:

Ana (Docs): Noted. I left two inline <!-- TODO --> markers where snippets need to be swapped. One is under "Embeddings: model change" and one in the SDK examples section.

Matt (Eng): Re: embed swap — runtime will fallback to the compat shim for seeded requests but we'll be removing that in the deprecation window. Can you add a note about behavior if customers pin to older aliases? e.g., automatic alias mapping is best-effort.

Ana (Docs): Good call. I'll add a short "compat and fallback" section. Matt, can you paste a 1-2 line example of what the runtime logs look like when a fallback happens? That helps docs people.

Matt (Eng): Sure: ``[2026-02-28T15:12:44Z] warn: alias-mismatch fallback applied: requested model=redwood-embed-v1 -> routed to redwood-embed-v2-compat``

Brian (SDK): Also we should surface the new error shape when passing the old param. Example: ``{ "error": "invalid_param", "details": "use 'modelName' instead of 'model'" }`` — small snippet in migration table will prevent confusion.

Emily (QA): Can we add a short checklist for regressions to run after customers swap embeddings? Things I care about: dimension mismatch, nearest-neighbor scoring drift, and sample-based semantic checks. I can author a 5-step smoke test if folks want.

Ana (Docs): Yes please — add the smoke test steps as a collapsible checklist. Tag it as "recommended pre-swap validation".

Sasha (PM): Timeline — legal/comms wants the deprecation announcement to go out two weeks before the cutover. Proposed cutover: 2026-03-31. Announcement target: 2026-03-17. That gives docs + SDK time to sync.

Brian (SDK): We'll land SDK snippet PR today and cut a patch release that deprecates `model` and warns at runtime. I'll also add a migration helper function: ``migrateModelParam(oldParams)`` (returns new param set).

Ana (Docs): Excellent. Can you paste the helper function in the thread when it's pushed? I'll grab it for the examples.

devdocs-bot: CI passed for docs PR #4123 — 8/8 checks OK. Preview deployed: https://docs-preview.redwood.ai/migration/v1-to-v2-embed

Emily (QA): Adding smoke test draft as requested. Quick checklist:
- Step 1: Verify embed dims (expected 1536 -> actual 1536)
- Step 2: Run sample set through old vs new model and check cosine similarity > 0.92 for 90% of samples
- Step 3: Validate nearest-neighbor ranking for 50 curated queries
- Step 4: Ensure SDK example responses match new JSON schema (fields: embedding, modelName, meta)
- Step 5: Check logs for warnings about alias fallback

Ana (Docs): Perfect — I'll slot that into the migration guide under "QA checklist" and credit Emily.

Sasha (PM): One more ops note — please include a short section in docs about rollout options: immediate swap, staged alias mapping, and canary traffic to Dedicated. Ops will want the canary steps documented.

Matt (Eng): I'll add a 3-step canary doc snippet for Dedicated customers (how to route 5%/25%/100%) and the config keys: `rollout.percent`, `rollout.window`, `fallback.policy`.

Brian (SDK): Pushed snippet PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-js/pull/780 — includes `migrateModelParam` helper and updated embed sample. Link to patch: https://npm.redwood.ai/package/@redwood/sdk/v2.1.4

Ana (Docs): grabbed it. I'll update the SDK examples and change the sample output JSON. Also will add a short migration note for TypeScript users about the param rename.

devdocs-bot: Preview updated for docs PR #4123 (includes SDK snippet). Preview link: https://docs-preview.redwood.ai/migration/v1-to-v2-embed?snippet=780

Brian (SDK): FYI — the TS types now emit a deprecation console.warn when `model` is used. Example console text: "[redwood-sdk] 'model' is deprecated: use 'modelName' — automatic migration applied."

Emily (QA): After Brian's release I'll run the smoke tests on staging and report results in this thread. ETA EOD tomorrow.

Ana (Docs): Thanks everyone — I'll request formal review once I fold in the snippets and QA checklist. If no objections, we'll queue the deprecation announcement for 2026-03-17. :calendar: :loudspeaker:

Sasha (PM): Sounds good. @devdocs-bot remind us in 7 days to check announcement assets.

devdocs-bot: Reminder scheduled for 3301600000 (7 days).
